name: klayson
description: Klayson is the brand and design source of truth for your agent: it reads your brand guide (logo, colors, typography, voice, layout, components and a page for each medium) before it builds anything, edits the guide with you, extracts the brand of any website, and checks what your agent made against the brand.

interface.shortDescription: Your brand guide, read before Codex builds
interface.longDescription: Klayson is your brand's source of truth for agents. Each brand is a guide of pages (logo, colors, typography, voice, imagery, layout, components, and one for each medium such as web, app, slides and email), read from your website, your PDF guide and your code, and edited by your team. Codex reads it before it builds anything for the brand, extracts the brand of any other website when the job needs one, and checks what it made against the brand. Needs a Klayson account: signing in for the first time makes one on the Free plan, with no card.
defaultPrompt: Use Klayson to set up my brand guide from my website and this codebase.
Read my brand from Klayson and follow it in this project.
Check this page against my brand with Klayson.
